Metadata.title: GeoBar — Find your kind of buteco
Metadata.description: A new way to explore the bars and neighborhoods of Belo Horizonte. Find your kind of buteco with GeoBar.

casa-da-esquina.description: A sidewalk table, something cold, and a conversation with no closing time.
casa-da-esquina.story: A neighborhood buteco where you can take your time and let the conversation flow. Sidewalk tables come together as the evening unfolds, while sharing plates arrive at the counter.
casa-da-esquina.hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 5 PM to midnight.

quintal-do-sol.description: An open-air backyard made for a slow afternoon that turns into an evening.
quintal-do-sol.story: A leafy backyard in the heart of Savassi, with room to enjoy a slow afternoon and stay into the evening. Food to share, an open-air table, and good company are all part of the plan.
quintal-do-sol.hours: Wednesday to Sunday, noon to 11 PM.

balcao-da-prosa.description: Good company at the counter, a little live music, and one more round.
balcao-da-prosa.story: A welcoming counter in Floresta for discovering music and starting a new conversation. Live performances go well with sharing plates and small groups of friends.
balcao-da-prosa.hours: Thursday to Sunday, 6 PM to 1 AM.

About.eyebrow: More than a place on the map
About.description: A buteco is more than a bar. It's the familiar corner, the table that keeps growing, and the afternoon nobody wants to end.
About.invitation: GeoBar is an invitation to explore Belo Horizonte through its neighborhoods and the places that bring people together.

Footer.description: Made with curiosity. Inspired by BH.
